name: 301. Batch contract: named key, inline lines through the sync converter, result paging, metadata (batch-contract)
description: Wire-level pins for the batch contract between Tokun and the gateway (TXE-6427; contract clauses C3, C4, C7, C8). Rows: (1) batch retrieve, cancel and results call upstream with the key the caller names in x-bf-api-key or x-bf-api-key-id and with no other key, and report it in x-bifrost-routing-info-key. The row stands up a run-scoped provider on the OpenAI base with a dead key and a live key, both enabled for batches, and asks for a batch id that does not exist: the dead key answers 401 for free and the live key 404, so the status says which key was called; before the change the gateway walked every key of the provider and reported none. A name that is no key of the provider is a 400 with no upstream call. (2) a results limit that is not a positive integer is refused instead of read as "everything". (3) a Gemini batch with no model is refused; it used to run on a default model. (4) a Gemini line whose url is not a generateContent operation, and (5) a line naming a model other than the batch's, are refused naming the line; nothing is sent upstream. (6) [PREVIEW] a Gemini inline line in OpenAI shape reaches the vendor through the sync converter: the echoed request body carries maxOutputTokens, temperature and the JSON response format, which the old conversion dropped, and the line's custom_id and url in its metadata; the batch is cancelled at once. (7) an OpenAI file upload's expires_after form fields reach the vendor, which returns expires_at; the file is deleted. (8) [PREVIEW] an OpenAI inline batch create sends metadata and output_expires_after; the batch is cancelled at once. (9) Vertex batch metadata that cannot be a job label is refused naming the entry, before anything is uploaded. (10) the Vertex batch list sends the caller's label filter upstream: a filter no job matches returns no jobs. The Azure deployment-name rewrite and the merged, paged result lines need a settled batch on a live account and are pinned by Go tests against a stand-in vendor instead. Run with FEATURE="batch-contract".
